mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a monetary policy tightening response from the Fed and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by >25bp in the following 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals increasing supply-side pressures that will drive inflation higher and lead to a monetary policy tightening response, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth accelerates by >2pp but CPIAUCSL remains below 3% over the next 6 months, or SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the month-over-month change in RSAFS, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive earnings revisions lower and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: M/M RSAFS growth drops by >1.5pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate, combined with a flattening of the yield curve as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals a tightening of financial conditions that will drive equity market volatility higher and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and T10Y2Y < 0.5% but SPX 20-day realized volatility is below 15% in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, as measured by the 3-month moving average of the month-over-month change in PAYEMS, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer confidence and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3M MA of M/M PAYEMS growth > 0.5% but consumer confidence (UMCSENT) does not rise by >2pts over the next 3 months, or SPX 60-day returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts, as measured by the month-over-month change in HOUST, combined with a low unemployment rate, signals a strong consumer sector that will drive earnings growth and produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: M/M HOUST growth > 5.0% and UNRATE < 5.0% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL, signals increasing inflationary pressures that will drive a monetary policy tightening response from the Fed and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y CPIAUCSL growth > 3.0% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by >50bp over the next 6 months, or SPX 60-day returns are positive >40% of the time.
